name: spec-to-pr
description: Evidence-backed Codex workflow for full brief delivery, legacy migration, feature E2E, and Figma implementation into draft pull requests.

interface.shortDescription: Turn briefs, migrations, features, and Figma into verified draft PRs.
interface.longDescription: SpecToPR provides four reviewer-first deliveries: brief, separate-project legacy migration, feature flow with a packet-bound video, and Figma UI. UI work always records measured visual comparison; API and binding uncertainty stays visible as a Gap instead of stopping confirmed work.
defaultPrompt: Use workflow_info, choose one of the four delivery modes, then call workflow_start once.
For UI, use Figma or the running legacy screen as the measured visual baseline; never treat skipped validation as passed.
Keep API or binding uncertainty as a reviewer-facing Gap and publish the compact four-template Draft body.
